title: What a free-trial user is told about the AI plan (iOS 1.8.29, simulator)
body:
New trial account on a Neon branch copy, iPhone 17 Pro simulator. Created a half-marathon plan (Regular, 8 weeks) to show every place the trial limit is explained.

## Where the user is told
- **Trial start (after onboarding):** "Try an AI training plan: your first 4 sessions are free" and "An AI training plan, with your first 4 sessions unlocked".
- **Generate plan screen, just above the button:** "Your free trial includes the first 4 sessions of your plan. You'll see the whole 8-week plan; upgrade to a plan with AI Plans to unlock the rest."
- **The plan itself:** a "Free trial plan" card ("0 of 4 free sessions done", **Unlock your full plan**). Sessions after the 4th say "Unlock with AI Plans", and weeks 3–8 are blurred with "Week N · Unlocks with AI Plans".

## Problems found
- **4, not 5.** Every screen and the server (`TRIAL_PLAN_SESSION_CAP = 4`, both of Jade's plans have `trial_session_cap = 4`) say 4 sessions. See the question below.
- **"You'll see the whole 8-week plan" isn't quite true.** Only weeks 1–2 are built on the trial; weeks 3–8 are blurred placeholders.
- **The plans tab's empty state** ("No Training Plan Yet") doesn't mention the trial at all.
- **"Great work! Today's workout is done"** shows on the plan's Today card on a day with no session (here, the day before the plan starts), with nothing run.
- **"0/8 workouts done"** counts the 4 locked sessions.

images.caption: Generate plan screen: the trial notice above the button
End of onboarding: what the trial includes
The plan: Free trial plan card and the Today message
Week 2: sessions after the 4th are locked
Weeks 3–8: blurred, unlock with AI Plans
Plans tab before a plan: no trial mention

title: Jade Batchelor: two accounts, two half-marathon plans (free trial)
body:
Both accounts were created on iOS 1.8.28 on 22 Nov with the same date of birth, "Regular" level and a paired Garmin watch. Neither has a real run yet.

## What she did
- **Account 1 (15:00):** onboarding, goal, 3 failed Strava connects, a 4-second watch session (saved as a 0 km "Afternoon Run"), then an **8-week, 4 days/week** plan at 15:22. She opened the week-1 long run twice, **skipped it**, then deleted her goal, which cancelled the plan.
- **Account 2 (17:01):** same onboarding, Garmin paired, 1 failed Strava connect, then a **17-week, 3 days/week** plan at 17:07. She opened the week-1 long run. No run since.
- **Why a second account:** probably because the trial allows one plan for the whole trial, so after cancelling she couldn't make another. That's inferred from the timing; nothing logs a refusal.

## The plans
- **No orientation run in either plan.** Both start with a long run (6.5 km and 7 km) on the day she signed up, and every session's text says "Specific targets will appear once your orientation run is complete". With no orientation session, that never happens: enrichment only fires when an `orientation` workout is completed (`plan-run-sync.ts`), and the stalled-plan fallback skips plans without one (`session-enrichment-service.ts`, `if (!orientation?.scheduledDate) continue`). So her sessions will keep their placeholder targets (no paces). The prompt asks for an orientation first, but nothing checks it. The test plan I made today did get one, and a 20 Nov 5K plan had it second. **This is the main thing to fix.**
- **The first free session was already missed.** Account 2's week 1 is a single 7 km long run on Sunday 22 Nov, scheduled for the evening she signed up. That is 1 of her 4 free sessions. The other three are Tue easy 5 km, Thu fartlek 6 × 1 min, and Sun long run 8 km. Week 3 (5.5 km easy, 2 × 10 min tempo, 9 km long run) is locked.
- **Load:** account 2 builds 7 → 18.5 → 20.5 km a week, which is sensible for a stated 15 km a week. Account 1's week 2 was 22.5 km over 4 runs (+50% on 15 km), which looks above the week-on-week cap. I haven't found why the gate allowed it.
- **Zones** (age 35): Z2 110–129, Z4 147–166 bpm. Reasonable.
- **Text:** account 2's week 3 says "an easier week follows at the start of the next block", but a trial plan has no next block until she upgrades. Minor.

## Other things she hit
- **Strava:** 4 attempts across both accounts, all refused (503, new Strava connections are paused while the Strava app is at its athlete limit). iOS 1.8.28 was meant to hide the Strava card, so some entry point still shows it. Not traced yet.
- **Garmin:** the 4-second, 0 km watch session was saved as a run.

title: Trial plan: 4 free sessions or 5? And fix the missing orientation run?
body:
**1. Free sessions.** You described the trial as the first 5 sessions, but the server cap and every screen say 4. Keep 4, or change to 5? Changing it means `TRIAL_PLAN_SESSION_CAP` plus the copy on both apps (onboarding, generate screen, subscription screen). Existing trial plans keep their stored cap of 4 unless I update them too.

**2. Orientation.** Shall I make the plan gate always put an orientation run first for runners with no history (and convert the first session if the AI leaves it out)? And make Jade's plan, and any other plan without one, get its targets after the first real run instead of never?

**3. Copy.** Shall I change the generate-screen line to something like "You'll see the first 2 weeks; the rest of the plan unlocks with AI Plans", and fix the "Today's workout is done" message on days with no session?
